properties.name: csproj_formatter_sort_entries
properties.description: Sorts supported PropertyGroup and ItemGroup entries alphabetically while preserving dependency order.

properties.name: csproj_formatter_empty_lines_between_groups
properties.description: Controls how many empty lines are inserted between top-level groups. Use a non-negative integer; 0 disables extra blank lines.

properties.name: csproj_formatter_sort_item_types
properties.description: Comma-separated item types whose homogeneous, include-only groups are sorted. Use * to allow every item type.
defaultValue: AdditionalFiles, Analyzer, Compile, Content, EmbeddedResource, FrameworkReference, InternalsVisibleTo, None, PackageReference, ProjectReference, Reference, Using
